$comment: Entry schema for contributes.jsonValidation (declarative and process plugins, manifest apiVersion 2). Host validation lives in backend/plugin/contrib_json_validation.go. fileMatch patterns use the customEditors glob alphabet and path rules, must end in .json or .jsonc and keep at least 3 literal characters in the file name before that extension (so *.json, **/*.json and ?.json are refused). The schema is a package-relative .json file under schemas/ or assets/ (max 1 MiB): strict JSON (no comments, no duplicate keys) with an object root, depth <= {{limits.schemaMaxDepth}}, <= {{limits.schemaMaxNodes}} nodes, only same-document $ref/$dynamicRef/$recursiveRef (starting with #), no $id below the root (a root $id/id is dropped), and <= {{limits.schemaRegexMax}} pattern/patternProperties regexes of <= {{limits.schemaRegexMaxLength}} characters. MinCode never fetches remote schemas; unsafe regexes are rejected in the editor.
description: JSON schema associations: validate and complete matching JSON files in the editor with a schema shipped in the package.

items.description: Case-insensitive glob (** any path, * and ? within one segment); matched against the basename, or against the project-relative path when it contains '/'. Examples: .mcp.json, **/.cursor/mcp.json, *.mcdemo.json.

schema.description: Package-relative JSON schema file, for example schemas/settings.schema.json. The path is the entry id.
